# Lowercase tags are HTML, not components

Per the locked heuristic (docs/04), a component tag starts with `[A-Z]` or
contains a dot. These are HTML and follow the HTML policy instead:

<div class="wrapper">
  <p>block html</p>
</div>

Inline: <span>text</span>, <br>, <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>.

These are components:

<Div />

<my.component prop="dotted lowercase still counts" />
